tasks.label: Build canteen menu
tasks.command: gcc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -c menu.c -o menu.o && gcc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -c confirmedorders.c -o confirmedorders.o && gcc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -c kitchen_queue.c -o kitchen_queue.o && gcc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -c logs.c -o logs.o && g++ -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic main.cpp ordering.cpp seating.cpp menu.o confirmedorders.o kitchen_queue.o logs.o -o canteen_menu
tasks.detail: Builds the C menu, order, kitchen queue, and logging modules with the C++ application.
